name: m365gov-governance

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Multiple Microsoft native control planes
authoritativeControlOwner.sentinelRole: Summary, correlation, operational health, coverage, and native investigation routing

freshness.expected: Uses per-source data-health thresholds and a 24-hour native-alert display window.

limitations: Sentinel-visible coverage does not represent every licensed, configured, or effective native control.
Entity correlation depends on identifiers supplied by native alert providers.
The Interaction Content tab displays prompt and response text only when collection was deployed as Enabled; workbook access cannot be restricted per tab.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Missing and silent sources remain visible as coverage gaps; empty alert views are not evidence that no alerts exist.
